decisions.reason: Naming the required webfont assets does not provide the per-style font-family mapping or otherwise change the existing token-sheet specification.
The required font families do not change the obligation to provide a numeric maximum content width.
The webfont-family identification does not alter the confirmed responsive breakpoint guidance.
The message identifies pending font assets used by the wizard, but it does not change the wizard's styling guidance values; the asset requirement independently owns the required family names.
The landing-page direction already specifies Alan Sans for headlines, and the wizard-focused source does not assign Plus Jakarta Sans or otherwise revise the landing-page typography.
The required webfont families do not change the landing page's responsive-layout requirement.
The webfont asset decision does not alter the requirement for a landing-page sign-up button.
The source concerns font assets referenced by the provisioning wizard and does not assign these families to or otherwise revise the admin workspace shell.
The source does not change which hero text is emphasized or establish a new hero-specific typography rule.
The webfont-family identification does not change the shared-footer requirement or its page applicability.
The named font assets are compatible with but do not modify the selected plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
The required font families do not change the website's dark theme or its non-switchable theme behavior.
